evidence_snippets: Skip upgrade prerequisites The process for performing a skip upgrade isn't different from performing a sequential upgrade, but there are some additional prerequisites: Verify that the cluster is in a state where a skip upgrade doesn't violate cluster and node pool version rules : Before you start a skip upgrade for an admin or hybrid cluster, ensure that all of its managed user clusters are at the same minor version as the managing cluster.

Skip upgrades Starting with version 1.33, Google Distributed Cloud supports skip upgrades for all cluster types, letting you upgrade a cluster to a target version (1.33 or higher) that is two minor versions ahead of its current version in a single operation.

Before you start a skip upgrade for a user cluster, ensure that your clusters meet the following criteria: The associated managing admin or hybrid cluster is two minor versions higher than the user cluster.

evidence_snippets: User clusters must be either the same minor version as the admin cluster or one minor version lower than the admin cluster.
